plainTranslation: Love styles and values that flow together naturally. Comfortable, harmonious, genuinely pleasant. Failure mode: comfort with no challenge. A lovely foundation; make sure something else brings the heat.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: Your affections and tastes align. Ease, pleasure, and real enjoyment of each other. Let this be the low-drama center of the bond.
tension: The catch is quiet and easy to miss. Because you already agree, you may stop checking whether what you both want is still what you actually need. You can drift into the same comforts, the same purchases, the same pleasant routines, simply because they feel good and nobody is asking the question. Ease has a way of becoming unconscious.
advice: Keep choosing your pleasures on purpose instead of by habit. The shared taste is a real gift, but it gets more powerful when it has a direction, when you point it at the life you are actually trying to build rather than just the one that feels nice today.
